title: amberx-import@1
description: The AmberX web app → console data import: the manifest migrate.py keeps (what it created, what it replaced, every run), the amberx-ai@1 profile document as it is stored on the console (secrets replaced by credential names), and the alert-history@1 record the console's notification history is made of. Build move-amberx-web-app-into-the-console-amberx-andr, step s2.

relPath.description: Relative to the console's state folder (.axf-console).

credentialName.description: A key in the console credential store (secrets.env). Never the value.

sectionState.description: moved: apply wrote something this run. unchanged: everything was already there. in-place: the data already lives where the console reads it; checked and counted, nothing copied. empty: nothing to import. stays-on-axhub: not console data. skipped: left out with --only. conflict: a credential the console already holds with another value (left alone, exit 2). error: the section failed; the others still ran.

created.description: Everything apply made that did not exist before. Rollback removes exactly this.

secrets.description: Credential entries apply added to secrets.env (names only).

history.description: Alert ids whose legacy delivery record apply appended to alerts-history.jsonl.

backups.description: Files apply replaced: target path → where the pre-migration original was moved (migrations/amberx-import.bak/). Rollback moves them back. First replacement only, so the original survives repeated runs.

aiProfilesOnConsole.title: amberx-ai@1 as stored on the console
aiProfilesOnConsole.description: The AmberX router's document unchanged in shape (apps/amberx-droid/server/router.py), except that `key` and `refresh` never appear: `keyRef` / `refreshRef` name the credential-store entries (AMBERX_AI_KEY_<ID>, AMBERX_AI_REFRESH_<ID>), which the console loads into its environment at start. Per-kind fallbacks keep the AmberX names (AMBERX_<KIND>_API_KEY, AMBERX_CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN, AMBERX_CLAUDE_REFRESH_TOKEN).

alertHistoryRecord.title: alert-history@1
alertHistoryRecord.description: One line of .axf-console/alerts-history.jsonl: one alert delivered to one device (contract C35b). The console appends a record when it pushes an alert to a device and fills readAt / tappedAt from the device's acks. The import back-fills one `legacy` record per alert the AmberX app polled from the console before the history existed.

key.description: alert@1 key (source:title or the raiser's key)

device.description: amberx-devices device id, or `amberx-web` for legacy records

legacy.description: True when back-filled by the import rather than observed.
